payload.blocks: Phase 5 (release pickup) and phase 11's probe of it; phases 2, 8, 9 wait on their own answers.
payload.headline: Widen the heads-stable footprint by attempt_step.rs so a live head's requests can run the active release?

parts.cause: packages/run-supervisor/rust/src/attempt_step.rs owns that host check and payload choice. It is outside the footprint; the plan only expected head_request.rs and terminal.rs to change. head-request.mjs and its test, which also change, are already in the footprint.

options.cost: One footprint line and one unit.
options.does: Supervisor adds packages/run-supervisor/rust/src/attempt_step.rs; phase 5 adds a release-aware handover for the head-request route only, verified the same way, while attempt steps stay pinned to their original host.
options.gain: Closes p-ycausep3zs as planned: every live head picks up a new release on its next request, no restart.
options.harm: Touches the shared payload handover door; needs care so attempt steps stay pinned.
options.label: Widen footprint by attempt_step.rs

options.does: Drop the per-request switch; a new activation rotates live heads so they restart on the new release.
options.gain: No change to the handover door.
options.harm: Every activation restarts every head; the phase file rejected this as not reaching heads without a restart.
options.label: Rotate heads on activation instead

parts.recommendation: Widen footprint by attempt_step.rs: it is the only door that decides which host the route child runs.

scope.allows: Adding packages/run-supervisor/rust/src/attempt_step.rs to this plan's footprint for a head-request-only handover.
scope.forbids: Changing attempt-step pinning or verification for other runs, or any other footprint change.

parts.what: Phase 5 makes each head request run the newest activated release. The unit stopped before editing: the route child runs through attempt_step::exec_payload, which refuses any host other than the envelope's original one (host-version-mismatch) and picks the original payloadRoot.
